# #1826: Patch: the tests' unit_at, pick and fixture helpers come from the shared kits, and the check keeps it so
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Every new card test rewrites the same helpers by hand — "give me the unit in this lane", "build the pick-an-instance JSON", "register a fixture script". There are over a hundred copies across the test suites today, in slightly different signatures that drift a little more with each copy-paste. After this change the shared test kits provide them, the duplicates are deleted, and the repository's own check refuses new copies — the same treatment the `both`/`spread` and def-id helpers just got.

## Why

#1786 (engine `both`/`spread`), #1812 (card def ids) and #1814 (web stubs) set the pattern; these families are next:

- `fn unit_at(` — 44 definitions across `crates/cards/tests/cross/` (16 files), card scripts' `mod tests`, engine rules tests and `crates/luau/tests/kit.rs`, in three signature flavours.
- `fn at(`-style pick builders — ~30+ copies of the identical body `json!([{ "pick": "instance", "instanceId": card.id }])`.
- In the same homes: `register_fixture_script` x6 verbatim and `fixture` x9 in the cards cross tests (home exists: `tests/cross/mod.rs` beside `scenario`); `det` x6, `ai_options` x7, `js` x6 in `crates/ai/tests/ai/` (home exists: `support.rs`); `in_hand` x4 and `targets_of`/`tributes_of` x3 each.
- The gate: `SHARED_RULES_HELPERS` (`crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs:953-1009`) refuses a local `both`/`spread` only under `crates/engine/tests/rules`; after this consolidation it covers the new names per directory so they cannot regrow.

## Proposal

- The engine testkit gains `Scenario::unit_at(player, lane)` (panic-on-missing, the dominant shape) and pick-JSON builders (`pick::instance(&CardInstance)`, `pick::unit_at(&scenario, player, lane)`); the copies delete.
- The cross-test helpers move to `tests/cross/mod.rs`; the AI ones to `tests/ai/support.rs`.
- `SHARED_RULES_HELPERS` gains per-directory name lists covering the new helpers.

## Where it lands

`crates/engine` testkit (+ `tests/rules/fixtures/harness.rs`), `crates/cards/tests/cross/mod.rs`, `crates/ai/tests/ai/support.rs`, `crates/tools/tests/acceptance.rs`, and the ~80 test files whose copies delete. Test code only; no spec surface.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `grep "fn unit_at("` returns only the shared definitions; same for the pick builders, `register_fixture_script`, `fixture`, `det`, `ai_options`, `in_hand`, `targets_of`/`tributes_of`.
- [ ] The acceptance test fails a re-introduced local copy in each covered directory.
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` passes unchanged.

## Size and risks

Hard by file count (~80 files) but mechanical: delete a copy, import the shared name. The only real decision is signature drift — the shared helper takes the panic-on-missing shape and the few oddballs keep local copies where adapting would change meaning.

   pub fn unit_at(&self, player: impl SeatRef, lane: i32) -> CardInstance {
       let seat = player.seat_or(self.current.active);
       self.unit(seat, lane)

   use serde_json::{Value, json};

   pub fn instance(card: &CardInstance) -> Value {
       id(&card.id)

   pub fn card(s: &Scenario, card: impl Into<CardRef>) -> Value {
       instance(s.card(card))
   }
   pub fn unit_at(s: &Scenario, player: impl SeatRef, lane: i32) -> Value {

     /// The 1-based header lines of `text`'s one-instance pick builders: a function whose signature
     /// returns a `Value` and whose body, `//` comments aside, holds PICK_LITERAL closed by `}])` with no
     /// second `"pick"`.
     fn pick_builder_definitions(text: &str) -> Vec<usize> {
         let code: Vec<&str> = text.lines().map(|line| line.split("//").next().unwrap_or("")).collect();
         let mut found = Vec::new();
         let mut open: Option<usize> = None;
         let mut index = 0;
         while index < code.len() {
             if code[index].split_whitespace().any(|word| word == "fn") {
                 let header = index;
                 let mut signature = String::new();
                 while index < code.len() {
                     signature.push_str(code[index]);
                     if code[index].contains(['{', ';']) {
                         break;
                     }
                     index += 1;
                 }
                 open = signature
                     .split_once("->")
                     .is_some_and(|(_, returns)| returns.contains("Value"))
                     .then_some(header);
             }
             let builds_one = code
                 .get(index)
                 .and_then(|line| line.split_once(PICK_LITERAL))
                 .is_some_and(|(_, rest)| rest.contains("}])") && !rest.contains("\"pick\""));
             if let Some(header) = open.filter(|_| builds_one) {
                 found.push(header + 1);
                 open = None;
             }
             index += 1;
         }
         found
     }
